lesson.subtitle: Lesson 7 -- How Often? Giovanna's Week
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Giovanna de Fátima | Lesson 7 -- How Often?
lesson.grammar_point: adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) and their position in the sentence

listenings.text: Good morning, team. Here is the week. We always start at seven. The safety meeting is on Monday, and it is never on Friday. The engineer from London visits the tunnel twice a week, usually on Tuesday and on Thursday. We sometimes work on Saturday, but not this month. Questions? Ask me now.

My week is always the same. I usually go to the gym before work, three times a week. I never go on Monday, because I am too tired. I sometimes have dinner with my sister on Wednesday. On Friday I always watch a movie, and I often sleep before the end.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna always wakes up early. She usually takes the same road to the site. She sometimes stops for a coffee. She never arrives late. On Friday she often finishes at five.
